lethariel_vaun_a_wary_wardkeeper_scout.name: Lethariel Vaun, a wary wardkeeper scout
lethariel_vaun_a_wary_wardkeeper_scout.description: A cautious scout stationed here to watch for intruders who follow the wrong memories. She marks safe stone with chalk and warns that the corridor's inscriptions can be trusted only after they are spoken aloud.
aliases: Lethariel Vaun, a wary wardkeeper scout

orven_tideglass_a_drowned_path_ferryman.name: Orven Tideglass, a drowned-path ferryman
orven_tideglass_a_drowned_path_ferryman.description: A reed-thin ferryman with waterlogged boots and a lantern sealed in blue glass. He knows which canals are safe, which are watched, and which voices in the water are not human.

sister_aelwyn_a_masked_city_oracle.name: Sister Aelwyn, a masked city oracle
sister_aelwyn_a_masked_city_oracle.description: A masked oracle who speaks in tidal metaphors and reveals answers only when the party asks the right question. She understands the chamber's riddles and warns that incorrect certainty is more dangerous than ignorance.
aliases: Sister Aelwyn, a masked city oracle

arannis_vey_keeper_of_the_trial_chambers.name: Arannis Vey, keeper of the trial chambers
arannis_vey_keeper_of_the_trial_chambers.description: The chamber's official overseer, responsible for judging whether an answer is sincere, clever, or merely stolen. Arannis watches from the dais or a side alcove and may offer a trial instead of a fight.
aliases: Arannis Vey, keeper of the trial chambers

mirael_of_the_third_reflection_an_illusi.name: Mirael of the Third Reflection, an illusion-bound examiner
mirael_of_the_third_reflection_an_illusi.description: An examiner bound to the chamber's mirrored judgments, appearing in a surface of still water or polished stone. Mirael tests the party with layered illusions and can reveal hidden truths if properly engaged.
aliases: Mirael of the Third Reflection, an illusion-bound examiner

thalan_deepcurrent_a_trapped_maintenance.name: Thalan Deepcurrent, a trapped maintenance mage
thalan_deepcurrent_a_trapped_maintenance.description: Trapped behind a collapsed service grate, Thalan can describe the vault's maintenance routes and hidden fail-safes. He is anxious, brilliant, and desperate to be freed before the wards recycle the chamber.
aliases: Thalan Deepcurrent, a trapped maintenance mage

elarion_sableleaf_a_diplomatic_wardkeepe.name: Elarion Sableleaf, a diplomatic wardkeeper envoy
elarion_sableleaf_a_diplomatic_wardkeepe.description: An envoy tasked with preserving the vault's social protocols as carefully as its seals. He insists that any tribute taken must be balanced by a spoken oath or a returned favor.
aliases: Elarion Sableleaf, a diplomatic wardkeeper envoy

veyra_moonquill_a_dissident_scholar.name: Veyra Moonquill, a dissident scholar
veyra_moonquill_a_dissident_scholar.description: A hidden guest posing as a cousin, quietly comparing the house's erased portraits to old civic records and memory-lore.

captain_soryn_thal_leader_of_the_city_wa.name: Captain Soryn Thal, leader of the city watch
captain_soryn_thal_leader_of_the_city_wa.description: A disciplined watch captain overseeing crowd control, flood response, and the quiet suppression of rumors.
aliases: Captain Soryn Thal, leader of the city watch

maerith_the_unseen_cabal_strategist.name: Maerith the Unseen, cabal strategist
maerith_the_unseen_cabal_strategist.description: A hidden strategist who has already infiltrated the vault's periphery and now manipulates events through projected whispers and false reflections. Maerith is never where they seem to be, but their plans are written across the room's mirrored surfaces.

high_warden_caldorin_master_of_the_seal_.name: High Warden Caldorin, master of the seal lattice
high_warden_caldorin_master_of_the_seal_.description: The stern architect of the archive's sealing system, present here to inspect the ward lattice and determine whether the hidden vault should remain closed.
aliases: High Warden Caldorin, master of the seal lattice

ilyra_fen_a_frightened_witness_with_frag.name: Ilyra Fen, a frightened witness with fragmented memories
ilyra_fen_a_frightened_witness_with_frag.description: Ilyra clutches a broken shell pendant and repeatedly loses track of which passage she came from. She can describe flashes of hidden doors, but only if the party calms her and helps piece together her memories.
aliases: Ilyra Fen, a frightened witness with fragmented memories

high_warden_selvaris_final_authority_ove.name: High Warden Selvaris, final authority over the vault wards
high_warden_selvaris_final_authority_ove.description: The ultimate voice of the vault's security, appearing here in person or as a ward-projected overseer depending on how the party arrives. Selvaris will demand identification, then test whether the intruders are thieves, petitioners, or liabilities.
aliases: High Warden Selvaris, final authority over the vault wards

archivist_nymora_custodian_of_forbidden_.name: Archivist Nymora, custodian of forbidden records
archivist_nymora_custodian_of_forbidden_.description: A meticulous archivist in layered ink-stained robes, guarding restricted tablets and cataloguing which memories must never be spoken aloud.
aliases: Archivist Nymora, custodian of forbidden records

maerith_the_unseen_if_still_at_large.name: Maerith the Unseen, if still at large
maerith_the_unseen_if_still_at_large.description: A hidden cabal strategist who may appear here only in disguise, using the guildhall's records to erase or redirect evidence.
aliases: Maerith the Unseen, if still at large
